HOME / MANUFACTURING

From Resin to Dispatch in Five Stages

Every batch follows the same documented sequence on our Hot Runner moulding lines.

01

Raw Material Intake & Drying

Virgin PET resin from Indorama Dhunseri is moisture-tested on arrival and dried in dehumidified hoppers before it is cleared for production.

02

Hot Runner Injection Moulding

Dried resin is melted and injected through hot runner systems under controlled temperature and pressure for each SKU.

03

Cooling & Dimensional Inspection

Preforms cool before ejection, then team checks weight, neck gauge and visual quality against tolerance.

04

Polarised Light Testing

Every batch is inspected under polarised light to detect wall stress and crystallinity variation invisible to the naked eye.

05

Packing & Dispatch

Approved preforms are bagged, boxed and dispatched. Standard SKUs available for same-day dispatch.

HOME / QUALITY ASSURANCE

Quality is Checked, Not Assumed

Incoming resin CoA, in-process monitoring and polarised light inspection on every single batch.

01

Incoming Resin CoA

Every batch of virgin PET resin arrives with an Indorama Dhunseri Certificate of Analysis. IV, moisture, AA content and melting point verified before production.

02

In-Process Monitoring

Weight, neck gauge and visual checks run at a fixed sampling interval on every moulding line throughout the production run.

03

Polarised Light Inspection

Every batch is inspected under polarised light to detect stress, crystallinity variation and wall defects invisible to the naked eye.

Polarised Light Testing

Seeing What the Naked Eye Cannot

Polarised light reveals stress, wall uniformity and crystallinity inside each preform — our most critical quality gate before packing.

What Polarised Light Reveals

  • ✓Uniform rainbow pattern = consistent wall — cleared for packing
  • ✗Dark zones = stress concentration — batch rejected before dispatch
  • ✓Detects crystallinity variation causing blow-moulding failures
  • ✓Every preform from every batch checked, not just samples

Want to see our full quality report?

We share Indorama CoA and polarised light test results with every serious enquiry.
